metrics.name: monthly_recurring_revenue
metrics.description: Total normalized monthly revenue from active subscriptions, excluding one-time fees, professional services, and credits.

metrics.name: net_revenue_retention
metrics.description: Percentage of recurring revenue retained from an existing cohort of customers after 12 months, including expansions, contractions, and churn.

metrics.name: annual_recurring_revenue
metrics.description: Annualized value of active subscription contracts, normalized to a 12-month period. Excludes one-time and variable revenue.

metrics.name: customer_acquisition_cost
metrics.description: Total sales and marketing spend divided by the number of new customers acquired in the same period. Includes fully-loaded salaries, tooling, and ad spend.

metrics.name: product_qualified_lead_count
metrics.description: Number of free-tier or trial users who have hit a predefined product engagement threshold indicating readiness for a sales conversation.

metrics.name: daily_active_users
metrics.description: Count of distinct authenticated users who performed at least one meaningful action (page view excluded) within a calendar day.
metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) WHERE event_type NOT IN ('page_view') AND event_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1

metrics.name: feature_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of active accounts that used a given feature at least once within the last 30 rolling days.
metrics.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT account_id WHERE feature_used) / COUNT(DISTINCT active_account_id) * 100

metrics.name: time_to_first_value
metrics.description: Median number of days from account creation to the first instance where a user completes the core activation milestone (first report published).
metrics.formula: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY first_value_date - account_created_date)

metrics.name: ticket_first_response_time_p50
metrics.description: Median time in hours between a support ticket being opened and the first human response from the support team.
metrics.formula: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF('hour', created_at, first_response_at)) WHERE first_response_at IS NOT NULL

metrics.name: csat_score
metrics.description: Percentage of post-resolution customer satisfaction surveys rated 4 or 5 out of 5, calculated over a rolling 30-day window.

metrics.name: logo_churn_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of accounts that cancelled or did not renew in the measured period, relative to the starting account count.

metrics.name: pipeline_coverage
metrics.description: Ratio of total open pipeline value to quarterly revenue target, indicating headroom for hitting forecast.
metrics.formula: SUM(opportunity_amount WHERE stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost')) / quarterly_revenue_target

metrics.name: activation_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of new accounts that complete the agreed activation milestone within the onboarding window.

metrics.name: mql_volume
metrics.description: Number of marketing-qualified leads created during the reporting period according to the approved lead scoring model.
metrics.formula: COUNT(lead_id) WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'MQL' AND created_at BETWEEN period_start AND period_end

metrics.name: support_ticket_volume
metrics.description: Total number of new support tickets opened in the reporting period, segmented by channel and priority.
metrics.formula: COUNT(ticket_id) WHERE created_at BETWEEN period_start AND period_end
